update.continueWithout: Ci gaba ba tare da sabuntawa ba
update.readOnlyDiskImage: Pollis yana aiki ne daga hoton faifai, wanda ba a iya rubutu a kansa. Rufe Pollis, ja shi zuwa Applications, fitar da hoton faifan, sannan a buɗe shi daga Applications.
update.readOnlyTranslocated: macOS yana gudanar da Pollis daga wani wuri na wucin gadi da ba a iya rubutu a kansa. Rufe Pollis, fitar da shi daga Applications sannan a mayar da shi ta amfani da Finder, sannan a sake buɗe shi.
update.readOnlyTranslocatedHealed: macOS yana gudanar da Pollis daga wani wuri na wucin gadi da ba a iya rubutu a kansa wanda wani sabuntawa na baya ya bari. An gyara hakan. Rufe Pollis sannan a sake buɗe shi daga Applications.
update.readOnlyGeneric: Pollis ba zai iya sabunta kansa ba saboda wurin da yake ba a iya rubutu a kansa. Rufe Pollis, tabbatar yana cikin babban fayil na Applications (an matsar da shi can da Finder), sannan a sake buɗe shi.
